**Radscorpions** are insects found in Appalachia.

Radscorpions have venomous stingers, powerful claws, and have the ability to burrow underground.

- Can sometimes be found at Middle Mountain Cabins.
- Can sometimes be found at Graninger Farm.
- Can sometimes be found at the Freak Show.
- Can sometimes be found in the garden area between the Whitespring Resort and the Whitespring Golf Club.
- Can sometimes be found outside Top of the World, at the base of the elevator.
- Can be reliably found in Carleton Mine, both during and after the quest Cheating Death.
- Can sometimes be found at Kiddie Corner Cabins.
- Can spawn during the Event: Primal Cuts in the Ash Heap
- Four can be reliably found in Smith Farm.

Radscorpions appear in *Fallout 76*.
